visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair, wearing a white floral-patterned dress and carrying a small red shoulder bag, stands on a cobblestone street. She smiles and looks towards the camera. The background consists of traditional multi-story urban buildings in Istanbul. (2) The camera transitions to a low-angle pan of colorful, narrow buildings in shades of blue, red, and yellow, with green vines climbing up one facade. (3) A wide exterior shot of an ancient stone and brick structure, identified as the Chora Church, featuring domes and arched windows under a grey sky. (4) A series of interior shots display elaborate golden mosaics on the vaulted ceilings and domes of the church. The mosaics depict religious figures and scenes in intricate detail, illuminated by soft indoor lighting. (5) The woman stands in front of a vibrant spice stall in the Spice Bazaar. Large conical mounds of spices in various colors (yellow, red, brown) are arranged in the foreground. Shelves behind her are packed with boxes of tea and spices. (6) Exterior view of a large Ottoman-style mosque with multiple domes and tall minarets. Pigeons fly through the air, and a large crowd of people is visible in the foreground plaza under a blue sky with white clouds. (7) The woman stands inside a darkened room featuring an immersive digital art installation. Swirling blue and white light patterns are projected onto the curved walls and floor, creating a sense of being underwater or in a nebula.
